svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province
1. Do not scale. Use figured dimensions only.
2. Site plan dims in metres; building dims in mm.
3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum
4. Boundary and road reserve assumed from
aerial imagery. Confirm by cadastral survey
5. Land south of original 1.0 ha plot (0.80 ha)
to be secured before any further design.
6. Read with structural, civil, M&E and
Pavements, kerbs, channels, fencing, gates, markings
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
80 mm S-block ICBP, 35 MPa, herringbone 45°, jointing sand
150 mm C3 cement-stabilised gravel (UCS 1.5–3 MPa), 97 % Mod AASHTO
150 mm G5 natural gravel / laterite subbase, 95 % Mod AASHTO
Roadbed: in-situ ripped & recompacted 150 mm, 93 % Mod AASHTO (CBR ≥ 15 — TBC)
D1 — P1 HEAVY-DUTY BLOCK PAVING (bays, aisles, roads)
220 mm C35/20 jointed plain concrete, broom finish, 25 mm Ø × 450 dowels @ 300 at joints
D2 — P2 RIGID CONCRETE (gate throat, junction, DG bays)
60 mm rectangular ICBP, 30 MPa, stretcher bond
100 mm C25 concrete, broom finish, 4 m bays, sealed joints
Pavement thicknesses are preliminary for 80 kN standard axles, ≈ 2 × 10⁶ E80 over 20 years (100 bays × 2 turns/day). Final design by civil engineer to TRH 4 / CMA
concrete-block catalogue after DCP + CBR testing of the laterite subgrade.
D5 — 300 × 250 BARRIER KERB (bay ends / trailer stop)
Precast FB-type kerb, 30 MPa, on 150 mm C15 bed + haunch;
rear face to verge, front 150 mm upstand to pavement.
C30 in-situ, 75 mm dish, 200 mm under dish, A193 mesh;
Galvanised W-section pales 3 mm @ 150 c/c, triple-pointed;
D9 — MOTORISED SLIDING GATE (6.5 m opening) 1:100
Cantilever sliding gate 6.9 × 2.4 m, galv. RHS frame +
palisade infill; 1 000 kg operator, battery backup,
safety beams, loop detectors; 2 No. (entry / exit).
100 mm white thermoplastic lines (3 mm), retro-reflective;
bay numbers 600 mm high, white, at aisle end;
DG bays: 200 mm red/white hatching + 'FUEL TANKERS ONLY';
one-way arrows 6.0 m long, yellow, every 30 m;
zebra crossing 600 mm bars, 2.0 m wide.
20 m galv. octagonal mast (to M&E / structural)
Pad 2.5 × 2.5 × 1.5 m C30, 8 × M36 anchor bolts;
